purpose: Test suffix-local component refresh against ordinary actions and matched full-command persistence at the calibrated first-energy-tank endpoint.
schedule: Wave 1: triplets 0 and 1 concurrently, one per host. Complete all three arms of each triplet. Evaluate both comparison gates; a failed/futile gate or measurement failure stops dispatch. Only if both remain attainable, wave 2 runs triplets 2 and 3 on the same respective host/CPU set. No retries, replacement seeds, horizon extension or tuning. Check auxiliary balance before further dispatch.
pass_rule: For each comparison separately: at least 3/4 strict wins, at least 15% lower mean restricted cost and aggregate candidate CPU/elapsed totals <=1.25 times that control. Both-censored pairs tie. Stop when either three-win criterion is impossible. These are allocation rules, not power guarantees.
next_gate: Passing both comparisons earns separately registered independent confirmation and bounded MM2 transfer with the identical candidate. No boss/Wily breakthrough or untouched validation is inferred.
identity_difference: Only the action_correlation GamePolicies entry intentionally differs within a triplet; empty means the unchanged ordinary policy. The generic eval compare compatibility guard remains unchanged.

ordinary.criterion: Three strict wins and at least 15% lower mean restricted first-energy-tank admitted cost, plus CPU/elapsed totals at most 1.25 times control. Exploratory allocation gate, not statistical significance.
ordinary.early_stop: Only after a completed pair when three wins become impossible, or after measurement failure.

whole.criterion: Three strict wins and at least 15% lower mean restricted first-energy-tank admitted cost, plus CPU/elapsed totals at most 1.25 times control. Exploratory allocation gate, not statistical significance.
whole.early_stop: Only after a completed pair when three wins become impossible, or after measurement failure.
